scope: The reviewed connection clean-up switch of the staging connector (v1 PR 5, docs/briefs/v1-connection-health.md; ADR-0025 item 10, ADR-0031 items 1 and 3; SD3, docs/briefs/sd3-keep-orders-to-redact.md). Committed off: the connector's five-minute cron runs only the M2 PR-3 re-drives (received deliveries, undestroyed tokens of ended installations, the privacy deadline check) and the reconcile of open Reconnect items and of live connections that need reconnecting; it never asks the broker to read an installation's scopes back from Shopify, never deletes an uninstalled store's data itself, never closes a stuck delivery and never deletes an inbox delivery. A scope change still keeps the connection and its token (the delivery's scopes only narrow), a reinstall still works, and a customers/redact request still runs every registered customer-content handler, whatever the switch. It is turned on only by one reviewed commit that sets switch to on and adds MORROW_CONNECTION_CLEANUP "on" to the staging connector's vars: from then on the cron reads each live installation's granted scopes with its own token once a day (a read of the owner's store under ADR-0035 item 4), deletes the data of an installation uninstalled 48 hours ago whose shop/redact never completed (once, with its record; ADR-0031 item 3, which the owner approved), closes scope-change deliveries stuck for 24 hours, and deletes settled inbox deliveries past their 7-day clock (ADR-0031 item 1), the order ids a customers/* request listed with them, keeping any whose privacy request is still open, and erases in place the customers/data_request exports to the Owner past their 30 days (SD4, docs/packets/P09.T05c.md). edge:check refuses any mixed state; production has no switch until the ADR-0007 item 9 custody ADR.
